title: Economics of Demand-Side and Supply-Side Climate Policies
abstract: Should a jurisdiction seeking to cut greenhouse gas emissions use demand-side climate policies that target fossil fuel consumption? Or should it introduce supply-side policies that target extraction? My analysis points to a policy portfolio rather than an either/or choice. ``Leakage'' of emissions to unregulated jurisdictions can be mitigated by combining standard demand-side carbon emissions pricing with supply-side pricing of carbon extraction. Emissions pricing drives leakage by lowering fossil fuel prices abroad; extraction pricing counteracts this effect. Supply-side climate policies in practice, however, do not broadly price extraction but instead narrowly foreclose investments in fossil fuel infrastructure and are thus inefficient. To reduce carbon demand, an alternative to emissions pricing is support for clean energy. I emphasize reforms to transmission planning and utility governance as crucial for unlocking clean energy resources' potential, and I highlight the case for publicly supporting clean energy R&D, including green industrial policy, to reduce carbon emissions not just at home but also abroad. I close by discussing distributional consequences. Domestically, carbon pricing and clean energy subsidies have sharply different distributional profiles. Globally, carbon extraction pricing would harm low-income countries that are also fossil fuel importers, though there also exist low-income fossil fuel exporters that would benefit. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 一个寻求减少温室气体排放的司法管辖区，应当采用针对化石燃料消费的需求侧气候政策，还是应当采用针对化石燃料开采的供给侧气候政策？我的分析指向一种政策组合，而非二选一。将标准的需求侧碳排放定价与供给侧碳开采定价相结合，可以缓解排放向无监管司法管辖区的“泄漏”。排放定价会通过降低国外化石燃料价格而引发泄漏；开采定价则抵消这一效应。然而，现实中的供给侧气候政策并不对开采进行广泛定价，而是狭隘地禁止对化石燃料基础设施的投资，因此是低效的。作为排放定价的替代方案，清洁能源支持可以减少碳需求。我强调，输电规划与公用事业治理的改革对于释放清洁能源资源的潜力至关重要；我还指出，公共部门支持清洁能源研发（包括绿色产业政策）的理由，不仅在于减少国内碳排放，也在于减少国外碳排放。最后，我讨论分配后果。在国内，碳定价与清洁能源补贴的分配特征截然不同。在全球层面，对碳开采定价将损害同时也是化石燃料进口国的低收入国家，不过也存在将从中受益的低收入化石燃料出口国。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民，可以在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: Investment, Productivity, and Selection in the U.S. Shale Boom
abstract: The goal of this paper is to understand why output per well increased so dramatically during the shale boom. A core question is the extent to which production growth arose from changes in well site selection---i.e., changes in the underlying geological quality of the precise areas being drilled---or from changes in firms' operational decisions, such as changes in inputs and adoption of new technologies. We develop a joint model of well-level production and drilling decisions that allows us to address site selection that comes from firms' private ex ante signals of sites' underlying geologic quality and from firms' ability to learn about quality over time by observing drilled wells' production outcomes. The model is designed to account for not just whether but when sites are drilled. We estimate the model using data on drilling, production, and leasing from two major U.S. shale plays: the Bakken in North Dakota and the Haynesville in Louisiana. We find that site selection has been important: firms initially drilled areas for which they had initial signals of high quality, and then they later repeatedly drilled in areas that had positive production outcomes. But after accounting for selection, as well as reservoir depletion, firms' operational improvements emerge as the largest driver of output growth. These improvements occurred within firms, rather than being driven by reallocation of drilling activity to more productive firms. Price and cost data suggest that these gains were driven by improvements in the productivity with which firms brought together drilling inputs.
abstract_zh: 本文旨在理解页岩气热潮期间每口井的产量为何大幅增长。一个核心问题是，产量增长在多大程度上源于井位选择的变化，即所钻探具体区域的底层地质质量的变化，或者源于企业运营决策的变化，例如投入要素的变化以及新技术的采用。我们构建了一个关于单井产量与钻井决策的联合模型，该模型能够处理以下两种井位选择：一是源于企业对井位底层地质质量的私人事前信号，二是企业通过观察已钻井的产量结果而随时间推移学习质量的能力。该模型不仅考虑了是否钻井，还考虑了钻井的时间。我们利用美国两个主要页岩气区块（北达科他州的巴肯和路易斯安那州的海恩斯维尔）的钻井、产量和租赁数据对模型进行了估计。我们发现，井位选择一直十分重要：企业起初在其初始信号显示高质量的区域钻井，之后则在产量结果良好的区域反复钻井。但是，在考虑了选择效应以及储层枯竭之后，企业的运营改进成为产出增长的最大驱动因素。这些改进发生在企业内部，而非由钻井活动向更高生产率企业的再分配所驱动。价格与成本数据表明，这些收益是由企业组织钻井投入要素的生产率提高所推动的。

title: Impacts of the Jones Act on U.S. Petroleum Markets
abstract: We study how the Jones Act — a 100-year-old U.S. regulation that constrains domestic waterborne shipping — affects U.S. markets for crude oil and petroleum products. We collect data on U.S. Gulf Coast and East Coast fuel prices, movements, and consumption, and we estimate domestic non-Jones shipping costs using freight rates for Gulf Coast exports. We then model counterfactual prices and product movements absent the Jones Act, allowing shippers to arbitrage price differences between the Gulf and East Coasts when they exceed transport costs. Eliminating the Jones Act would have reduced average East Coast gasoline, jet fuel, and diesel prices by $0.63, $0.80, and $0.82 per barrel, respectively, during 2018–2019, with the largest price decreases occurring in the Lower Atlantic. The Gulf Coast gasoline price would increase by $0.30 per barrel. U.S. consumers’ surplus would increase by $769 million per year, and producers’ surplus would decrease by $367 million per year.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了《琼斯法案》（一项有100年历史的美国法规，限制国内水运）如何影响美国的原油和石油产品市场。我们收集了美国墨西哥湾沿岸和东海岸的燃料价格、流动与消费数据，并利用墨西哥湾沿岸出口的运费数据，估算了国内非《琼斯法案》航运的成本。随后，我们在不存在《琼斯法案》的假设下，构建了价格和产品流动的反事实模拟，允许托运人在墨西哥湾与东海岸之间的价差超过运输成本时进行套利。在2018至2019年间，废除《琼斯法案》本可使东海岸汽油、航空煤油和柴油的平均价格分别每桶下降0.63美元、0.80美元和0.82美元，其中下降幅度最大的是南大西洋地区。墨西哥湾沿岸的汽油价格则将每桶上涨0.30美元。美国消费者剩余每年将增加7.69亿美元，而生产者剩余每年将减少3.67亿美元。

title: Drilling Deadlines and Oil and Gas Development
abstract: Oil and gas leases between mineral owners and extraction firms typically specify a date by which the firm must either drill a well or lose the lease. These deadlines are known as primary terms. Using data from the Louisiana shale boom, we first show that well drilling is substantially bunched just before the primary term deadline. This bunching is not necessarily surplus‐reducing: using an estimated model of firms' drilling and input choices, we show that primary terms can increase total surplus by countering the effects of leases' royalties, as royalties are a tax on revenue and delay drilling. These benefits are reduced, however, when production outcomes are sensitive to drilling inputs and when drilling one well indefinitely extends the period of time during which additional wells may be drilled. We enrich the model to consider mineral owners' lease offers and find small effects of primary terms on owners' revenue.
abstract_zh: 矿产所有者与开采公司之间的石油和天然气租约，通常会规定一个期限，在此之前公司必须钻井，否则将失去租约。这些期限被称为“主期限”。利用路易斯安那页岩热潮的数据，我们首先表明，钻井活动在主期限截止日期前明显集中。这种集中不一定会减少剩余：利用一个对公司钻井和投入选择进行估计的模型，我们表明，主期限可以通过抵消租约特许权使用费的影响而增加总剩余，因为特许权使用费是对收入征收的税，并会延迟钻井。然而，当产量结果对钻井投入敏感，以及一口井的钻探会无限期延长可以继续钻其他井的时期时，这些收益会减少。我们对模型加以扩展，以考虑矿产所有者的租约报价，并发现主期限对所有者收入的影响很小。

title: Carbon Pricing, Clean Electricity Standards, and Clean Electricity Subsidies on the Path to Zero Emissions
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: We categorize the primary incentive-based mechanisms under consideration for addressing greenhouse gas emissions from electricity generation—pricing carbon, setting intensity standards, and subsidizing clean electricity—and compare their market outcomes under similar expansions of clean electricity generation. Although pricing emissions gives strong incentives to first eliminate generation with the highest social cost, a clean electricity standard incentivizes earliest phaseout of the generation with the highest private cost. We show that the importance of this distinction depends on the correlation between private costs and emissions rates. We then estimate this correlation for US electricity generation and fuel prices as of 2019. The results indicate that the emissions difference between a carbon tax and clean electricity standard that phase out the fossil fuel generation over the same time frame may actually be quite small, though it depends on fossil-fuel prices during the phaseout. We also discuss how each of these policy options is likely to affect electricity prices, quantity demanded, government revenue, and economic efficiency. Large preexisting markups of retail electricity prices over marginal costs are likely to considerably weaken or even reverse the usual assumed efficiency advantage of carbon pricing policies over alternatives, including direct subsidization of clean electricity generation.
abstract_zh: 我们对当前考虑中的、用于应对发电温室气体排放的主要基于激励的机制进行了分类——为碳定价、设定强度标准以及补贴清洁电力，并在类似的清洁电力扩张规模下比较了它们的市场结果。尽管为排放定价会促使人们率先淘汰社会成本最高的发电，但清洁电力标准则会激励人们最早淘汰私人成本最高的发电。我们表明，这一区别的重要性取决于私人成本与排放强度之间的相关性。随后，我们根据2019年美国的发电和燃料价格，估计了这种相关性。结果表明，在相同时间框架内淘汰化石燃料发电的碳税与清洁电力标准之间的排放差异可能相当小，不过这取决于淘汰期间的化石燃料价格。我们还讨论了每种政策选择可能如何影响电价、需求量、政府收入和经济效率。零售电价相对于边际成本的既有较大加成，很可能会大大削弱甚至逆转通常所假定的碳定价政策相对于其他替代方案（包括直接补贴清洁电力发电）的效率优势。

title: Challenges of a Clean Energy Transition and Implications for Energy Infrastructure Policy
abstract: The United States faces the challenge of dramatically reducing carbon emissions while simultaneously ensuring the reliable supply of on-demand energy services that its residents have come to expect. Federal policy will be instrumental in driving investments in energy infrastructure that will be required to transition the U.S. energy supply to zero-emissions sources. This paper discusses the major barriers that policy will need to overcome in order to successfully execute this transition at a reasonable cost. A core problem is that wind and solar generation are intermittent. Provision of reliable zero-emission supply therefore requires combining wind and solar resources with investments in dispatchable zero-emission sources (such as nuclear, hydroelectric, geothermal, and fossil-fueled power plants with carbon capture and sequestration), long-distance transmission, demand flexibility, and storage technologies. But given uncertainties about technological progress, it is difficult to know which combination of investments will be most cost-effective. We argue that broad incentives -- such as carbon pricing, clean energy standards, or clean energy subsidies -- that do not discriminate across zero-emissions resources will be essential for directing capital toward cost-effective investments in clean energy infrastructure. We also argue, however, that such incentives on their own will be insufficient to meet the overall challenge. Policy must also address a suite of additional problems in energy markets that clean energy pricing incentives alone will not address. These problems include motivating global emissions reductions, overcoming regulatory barriers to long-distance transmission construction, addressing deficiencies in wholesale energy markets, reducing utilities' inclusion of non-marginal costs in volumetric retail rates, eliminating inequities in the distribution of clean energy's benefits and costs, and funding infrastructure decommissioning at the end of its useful life.
abstract_zh: 美国面临着大幅减少碳排放的挑战，同时还要确保其居民所期望的、可随时获取的可靠能源服务供应。联邦政策将在推动能源基础设施投资方面发挥关键作用，这些投资是将美国能源供应转向零排放来源所必需的。本文讨论了政策需要克服的主要障碍，以便以合理成本成功完成这一转型。一个核心问题是，风能和太阳能发电具有间歇性。因此，要提供可靠的零排放供应，就需要将风能和太阳能资源与可调度的零排放来源（例如核能、水电、地热，以及配备碳捕集与封存的化石燃料发电厂）的投资相结合，并辅以远距离输电、需求弹性和储能技术。然而，鉴于技术进步存在不确定性，很难知道哪种投资组合最具成本效益。我们认为，碳定价、清洁能源标准或清洁能源补贴等广泛激励措施——它们对不同的零排放资源不加歧视——对于引导资本流向具有成本效益的清洁能源基础设施投资至关重要。然而，我们也认为，仅靠此类激励措施本身仍不足以应对整体挑战。政策还必须解决能源市场中的一系列其他问题，而清洁能源定价激励本身无法解决这些问题。这些问题包括：促使全球减排、克服远距离输电建设的监管障碍、解决批发能源市场的缺陷、减少公用事业将非边际成本计入按量计价零售电价的做法、消除清洁能源收益与成本分配中的不公平现象，以及为能源基础设施在其使用寿命结束后的退役提供资金。

title: Energy and Environmental Markets, Industrial Organization, and Regulation
abstract: This paper discusses contributions that industrial organization economists have made to our understanding of energy markets and environmental regulation. We emphasize the substantive contributions of recent papers while also highlighting how this literature has adopted and sometimes augmented theoretical and empirical tools from industrial organization. Many of the topics examined by this literature—especially auctions, investment, productivity and innovation, and regulation—also apply to a variety of settings beyond energy and the environment. We also indicate areas where future research is likely to be fruitful, with an emphasis on how industrial organization economists can help inform energy and environmental policies.
abstract_zh: 本文讨论了产业组织经济学家对我们理解能源市场和环境监管所作出的贡献。我们强调近期论文的实质性贡献，同时也指出了该文献如何采纳并有时扩充了产业组织理论和实证工具。该文献所考察的许多主题——尤其是拍卖、投资、生产率与创新，以及监管——也适用于能源与环境之外的诸多领域。我们还指出了未来研究可能富有成效的领域，并强调产业组织经济学家如何帮助为能源和环境政策提供信息。

title: Output and Attribute-Based Carbon Regulation Under Uncertainty
abstract: Output-based carbon regulations-such as fuel economy standards and the rate-based standards in the Clean Power Plan-create well-known incentives to inefficiently increase output. Similar distortions are created by attribute-based regulations. This paper demonstrates that, despite these distortions, output and attribute-based standards can always yield greater expected welfare than "flat" emission standards given uncertainty in demand for output (or attributes), assuming locally constant marginal damages. For fuel economy standards, the welfare-maximizing amount of attribute or mileage-basing is likely small relative to current policy. For the electricity sector, however, an intensity standard may yield greater expected welfare than a flat standard.
abstract_zh: 基于产出的碳监管——例如燃油经济性标准以及《清洁电力计划》中的比率标准——会产生众所周知的激励，促使企业低效地增加产出。基于属性的监管也会产生类似的扭曲。本文证明，尽管存在这些扭曲，在对产出（或属性）需求存在不确定性的情况下（假设边际损害局部恒定），基于产出和基于属性的标准始终可以比“统一”的排放标准产生更高的预期福利。对于燃油经济性标准而言，相对于现行政策，福利最大化的基于属性或里程数的标准规模可能较小。然而，对于电力部门而言，强度标准可能比统一标准产生更高的预期福利。

title: Gasoline Price Uncertainty and the Design of Fuel Economy Standards
abstract: What are the implications of gasoline price volatility for the design of fuel economy policies?I show that this problem has a strong parallel to Weitzman's (1974) classic model of using price or quantity controls to regulate an externality. Changes in fuel prices act as shocks to the marginal cost of complying with the standard. Assuming constant marginal damages from fuel consumption, an application of Weitzman (1974) implies that a fixed fuel economy standard reduces expected welfare relative to a "price" policy such as a feebate or, equivalently, a fuel economy standard that is indexed to the price of gasoline. When the regulator is constrained to use a fixed standard, I show that the usual approach to setting the standard-equate expected marginal compliance cost to marginal damage-is likely to be sub-optimal because the standard may not bind if the realized gasoline price is sufficiently high. Instead, the optimal fixed standard will be relatively relaxed and may be non-binding even at the expected gasoline price. Finally, I show that although an attribute-based standard allows vehicle choices to flexibly respond to gasoline price shocks, the resulting distortions imply that the optimal fuel economy standard is not attribute-based.
abstract_zh: 汽油价格波动对燃油经济性政策的设计有何影响？我表明，这一问题与Weitzman（1974）关于运用价格控制或数量控制来规管外部性的经典模型有着很强的相似性。燃料价格变化会充当影响合规边际成本的冲击。假设燃料消费的边际损害恒定，运用Weitzman（1974）的结论可知，一个固定的燃油经济性标准，相对于诸如收费返还（feebate）这类“价格”政策，或者等价地，相对于一个与汽油价格挂钩的燃油经济性标准，会降低预期福利。当监管者被限制只能使用固定标准时，我表明，设定标准的通常做法——即令预期的边际合规成本等于边际损害——很可能是次优的，因为当实际汽油价格足够高时，该标准可能根本不具约束力。相反，最优的固定标准将相对宽松，甚至在预期汽油价格水平下也可能不具约束力。最后，我表明，尽管基于属性的标准允许车辆选择灵活地应对汽油价格冲击，但由此产生的扭曲意味着，最优的燃油经济性标准并不应当是基于属性的。

title: Hotelling Under Pressure
abstract: We show that oil production from existing wells in Texas does not respond to oil prices, while drilling activity and costs respond strongly. To explain these facts, we reformulate Hotelling’s classic model of exhaustible resource extraction as a drilling problem: firms choose when to drill, but production from existing wells is constrained by reservoir pressure, which decays as oil is extracted. The model implies a modified Hotelling rule for drilling revenues net of costs, explains why the production constraint typically binds, and rationalizes regional production peaks and observed patterns of prices, drilling, and production following demand and supply shocks.
abstract_zh: 我们表明，德克萨斯州现有油井的石油产量并不随油价变化，而钻井活动及其成本则对油价有强烈反应。为解释这些事实，我们将霍特林（Hotelling）关于可耗竭资源开采的经典模型重新表述为一个钻井问题：企业选择何时钻井，但现有油井的产量受到油藏压力的约束，而油藏压力会随着石油的开采而衰减。该模型推导出一种针对扣除成本后钻井收入的修正霍特林规则，解释了为何生产约束通常会具有约束力，并为区域产量峰值以及在需求和供给冲击之后价格、钻井和产量的观察模式提供了理论依据。

title: Climate Amenities, Climate Change, and American Quality of Life
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We present a hedonic framework to estimate US households’ preferences over local climates, using detailed weather and 2000 Census data. We find that Americans favor a daily average temperature of 65 degrees Fahrenheit, that they will pay more on the margin to avoid excess heat than cold, and that damages increase less than linearly over extreme cold. These preferences vary by location due to sorting or adaptation. Changes in climate amenities under business-as-usual predictions imply annual welfare losses of 1%–4% of income by 2100, holding technology and preferences constant.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个享乐框架，利用详细的天气数据和2000年人口普查数据，估计美国家庭对当地气候的偏好。我们发现，美国人偏好日均气温为华氏65度（约18摄氏度），他们为避免高温而额外支付的费用高于避免寒冷的费用，而且极端寒冷造成的损害增长速度低于线性。这些偏好因地点而异，原因在于人口分选或适应。在照常排放的预测下，气候舒适度的变化意味着到2100年，每年将造成相当于收入1%至4%的福利损失，前提是技术和偏好保持不变。

title: The Intergenerational Transmission of Automobile Brand Preferences: Empirical Evidence and Implications for Firm Strategy
abstract: We document a strong correlation in the brand of automobile chosen by parents and their adult children, using data from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics. This correlation could represent transmission of brand preferences across generations, or it could result from correlation in family characteristics that determine brand choice. We present a variety of empirical specifications that lend support to the former interpretation and to a mechanism that relies at least in part on state dependence. We then discuss implications of intergenerational brand preference transmission for automakers’ product‐line strategies and for the strategic pricing of vehicles to different age groups.
abstract_zh: 利用“收入动态追踪调查”（PSID）的数据，我们记录了父母与成年子女所选汽车品牌之间存在的强相关性。这种相关性可能代表了品牌偏好在代际之间的传递，也可能源于决定品牌选择的家庭特征之间的相关性。我们提出了多种实证设定，它们支持前一种解释，以及一种至少部分依赖于状态依赖性的机制。随后，我们讨论了代际品牌偏好传递对汽车制造商产品线策略，以及针对不同年龄群体的车辆战略定价的含义。

title: Welfare and Distributional Implications of Shale Gas
abstract: Technological innovations in horizontal drilling and hydraulic fracturing have enabled tremendous amounts of natural gas to be extracted profitably from underground shale formations that were long thought to be uneconomical. In this paper, we provide the first estimates of broad-scale welfare and distributional implications of this supply boom. We provide new estimates of supply and demand elasticities, which we use to estimate the drop in natural gas prices that is attributable to the supply expansion. We find large, positive welfare impacts for four broad sectors of gas consumption (residential, commercial, industrial, and electric power) and a negative impact for producers, with variation across regions. We then examine the evidence for a gas-led “manufacturing renaissance” and for pass-through to prices of products such as retail natural gas, retail electricity, and commodity chemicals. We conclude with a discussion of environmental externalities from unconventional natural gas, including limitations of the current regulatory environment. Overall, we find that between 2007 and 2013 the shale gas revolution led to an increase in welfare for natural gas consumers and producers of $48 billion per year, but more data are needed on the extent and valuation of the environmental impacts of shale gas production.
abstract_zh: 水平钻井和水力压裂技术的创新，使得大量原本被认为不经济的页岩地层中的天然气得以盈利性开采。在本文中，我们首次对这一供给热潮的广泛福利和分配影响进行了估计。我们提供了供给和需求弹性的新估计，并利用这些弹性估算了可归因于供给扩张的天然气价格下降幅度。我们发现，天然气消费的四个主要部门（居民、商业、工业和电力）获得了较大的正向福利影响，而生产者则受到负面影响，且存在地区差异。随后，我们考察了天然气推动“制造业复兴”的证据，以及其向零售天然气、零售电力和大宗化学品等产品价格的传导（pass-through）。最后，我们讨论了非常规天然气带来的环境外部性，包括当前监管环境的局限性。总体而言，我们发现，2007年至2013年间，页岩气革命使天然气消费者和生产者的福利每年增加了480亿美元，但仍需要更多数据，以评估页岩气生产的环境影响及其价值。

title: The Effect of Uncertainty on Investment: Evidence from Texas Oil Drilling
abstract: This paper estimates the response of investment to changes in uncertainty using data on oil drilling in Texas and the expected volatility of the future price of oil. Using a dynamic model of firms' investment problem, I find that: (i) the response of drilling activity to changes in price volatility has a magnitude consistent with the optimal response prescribed by theory, (ii) the cost of failing to respond to volatility shocks is economically significant, and (iii) implied volatility data derived from futures options prices yields a better fit to firms' investment behavior than backward-looking volatility measures such as GARCH. (JEL C58, D92, G13, G31, L71, Q31)
abstract_zh: 本文利用得克萨斯州的石油钻井数据及未来油价的预期波动率，估计了投资对不确定性变化的反应。通过对企业投资问题的动态模型，我发现：（i）钻井活动对价格波动率变化的反应，其幅度与理论所规定的最优反应相一致；（ii）未能对波动率冲击作出反应的成本在经济上是显著的；（iii）由期货期权价格得出的隐含波动率数据，比GARCH等回溯式波动率指标更能拟合企业的投资行为。（JEL C58, D92, G13, G31, L71, Q31）

title: The Incidence of an Oil Glut: Who Benefits from Cheap Crude Oil in the Midwest?
abstract: Beginning in early 2011, crude oil production in the U.S. Midwest and Canada surpassed the pipeline capacity to transport it to the Gulf Coast where it could access the world oil market. As a result, the U.S. “benchmark” crude oil price in Cushing, Oklahoma, declined substantially relative to internationally traded oil. In this paper, we study how this development affected prices for refined products, focusing on the markets for motor gasoline and diesel. We find that the relative decrease in Midwest crude oil prices did not pass through to wholesale gasoline and diesel prices. This result is consistent with evidence that the marginal gallon of fuel in the Midwest is still imported from coastal locations. Our findings imply that investments in new pipeline infrastructure between the Midwest and the Gulf Coast, such as the southern segment of the controversial Keystone XL pipeline, will not raise gasoline prices in the Midwest.
abstract_zh: 从2011年初开始，美国中西部和加拿大的原油产量超过了将其输送到墨西哥湾沿岸（以进入世界石油市场）的管道输送能力。结果，俄克拉荷马州库欣的美国“基准”原油价格相对于国际交易的石油大幅下跌。在本文中，我们研究了这一发展如何影响成品油价格，重点关注汽油和柴油市场。我们发现，中西部原油价格的相对下降并未传导至批发汽油和柴油价格。这一结果与以下证据相一致：中西部的边际加仑燃料仍然是从沿海地区进口的。我们的发现意味着，在中西部与墨西哥湾沿岸之间投资新的管道基础设施（例如备受争议的Keystone XL管道的南段），不会推高中西部的汽油价格。

title: What Do Consumers Believe About Future Gasoline Prices?
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: A full understanding of how gasoline prices affect consumer behavior frequently requires information on how consumers forecast future gasoline prices. We provide the first evidence on the nature of these forecasts by analyzing two decades of data on gasoline price expectations from the Michigan Survey of Consumers. We find that average consumer beliefs are typically indistinguishable from a no-change forecast, justifying an assumption commonly made in the literature on consumer valuation of energy efficiency. We also provide evidence on circumstances in which consumer forecasts are likely to deviate from no-change and on significant cross-consumer forecast heterogeneity.
abstract_zh: 要全面理解汽油价格如何影响消费者行为，往往需要了解消费者如何预测未来的汽油价格。我们通过分析密歇根消费者调查二十年来的汽油价格预期数据，首次提供了关于这些预测性质的证据。我们发现，消费者的平均信念通常与不变预测（no-change forecast）无法区分，这为文献中关于消费者对能源效率估价的常见假设提供了依据。我们还提供了证据，说明消费者预测在哪些情形下可能偏离不变预测，以及消费者之间预测存在显著异质性。

title: Career Concerns, Inaction, and Market Inefficiency: Evidence from Utility Regulation
abstract: We study how incentive conflicts known as ‘career concerns’ can generate inefficiencies not only within firms but also in market outcomes. Career concerns may lead agents to avoid actions that, while value‐increasing in expectation, could potentially be associated with a bad outcome. We apply this theory to natural gas procurement by regulated public utilities and show that career concerns may lead to a reduction in surplus‐increasing market transactions during periods when the benefits of trade are likely to be greatest. We show that data from natural gas markets are consistent with this prediction and difficult to explain using alternative theories.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了被称为“职业顾虑”的激励冲突如何不仅在企业内部、也在市场结果中产生低效率。职业顾虑可能会使代理人避免那些在期望中增加价值、但可能与不良结果相关联的行动。我们将这一理论应用于受监管的公用事业公司的天然气采购，并表明，职业顾虑可能导致在交易收益最有可能最大的时期，那些增加剩余的市场交易减少。我们表明，天然气市场的数据与这一预测相一致，并且难以用其他理论来解释。

title: Clearing the Air? The Effects of Gasoline Content Regulation on Air Quality
abstract: This paper examines whether US gasoline content regulations, which impose substantial costs on consumers, have successfully reduced ozone pollution. We take advantage of spatial and temporal variation in the regulations' implementation to show that federal gasoline standards, which allow refiners flexibility in choosing a compliance mechanism, did not improve air quality. This outcome occurred because minimizing the cost of compliance does not reduce emissions of those compounds most prone to forming ozone. In California, however, we find that precisely targeted, inflexible regulations requiring the removal of particularly harmful compounds significantly improved air quality. (JEL L51, L71, L78, Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国汽油成分规制是否成功降低了臭氧污染。这些规制给消费者带来了可观的成本。我们利用规制实施在空间和时间上的差异表明，允许炼油商灵活选择合规机制的联邦汽油标准，并未改善空气质量。之所以出现这一结果，是因为使合规成本最小化，并不能减少那些最易形成臭氧的化合物的排放。然而，在加利福尼亚州，我们发现，精准针对、要求去除特别有害化合物的刚性规制显著改善了空气质量。（JEL L51, L71, L78, Q53, Q58）

title: Forecasting Gasoline Prices Using Consumer Surveys
abstract: This paper analyzes the predictive power of a new data set of consumer gasoline price forecasts taken from the Michigan Survey of Consumers (MSC). MSC data generally perform as well as a no-change forecast in predicting future gasoline prices, and they substantially out-perform the no-change forecast during the recent economic crisis, during which time they track futures market prices. Finally, the cross-respondent dispersion of the MSC forecasts increases substantially during the economic crisis, paralleling the large increase in price volatility at this time.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了一组取自密歇根消费者调查（MSC）的新数据集中消费者汽油价格预测的预测能力。在预测未来汽油价格方面，MSC数据总体上与不变预测表现相当；而在近期的经济危机期间，它们显著优于不变预测，并且其走势与期货市场价格相吻合。最后，在经济危机期间，MSC预测在受访者之间的离散程度大幅上升，这与同期价格波动的大幅上升相呼应。

title: Learning by Drilling: Inter-Firm Learning and Relationship Persistence in the Texas Oilpatch
abstract: This paper examines the importance of learning-by-doing that is specific not just to individual firms, but to pairs of firms working together in a contracting relationship. Using new, detailed data from the oil and gas industry, I find that the joint productivity of an oil production company and its drilling contractor is enhanced significantly as they accumulate experience working together. This learning is relationship-specific: drilling rigs generally cannot fully appropriate the productivity gains acquired through experience with one production company to their work for another. This result is robust to other ex ante match specificities. Relationship-specific learning is consequential because it implies that relationship stability is important to productivity. When two firms accumulate experience working together, relationship-specific intellectual capital is created that cannot be appropriated to pairings with other firms. If the relationship is broken, this capital is destroyed and productivity decreases, thereby giving firms an incentive to maintain long-term relationships. Accordingly, the data indicate that production companies prefer to work with drilling rigs which they have accumulated considerable experience rather than those with which they have worked relatively little.I demonstrate that this contracting pattern is difficult to explain with switching costs or ex ante match specificities alone.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了一种学习过程的重要性，这种学习不仅专属于单个企业，也专属于在合同关系中共同合作的企业对。利用石油和天然气行业新的详细数据，我发现，石油生产公司与其钻井承包商之间的联合生产率，会随着他们共同合作经验的积累而显著提高。这种学习具有关系专属性：钻机通常无法将其与某一生产公司合作所获得的生产率收益，充分转移至其为另一家公司的工作之中。这一结果对于其他事前匹配特异性的影响是稳健的。关系专属性学习之所以重要，是因为它意味着关系的稳定性对生产率至关重要。当两家企业积累了共同合作的经验时，就会产生关系专属的智力资本，而这种资本无法转移到与其他企业的配对中。如果关系中断，这种资本就会消失，生产率随之下降，从而使企业有动机维持长期关系。因此，数据表明，生产公司更倾向于与其有大量合作经验的钻机合作，而非那些合作经验相对较少的钻机。我证明，仅凭转换成本或事前匹配特异性，难以解释这种签约模式。

title: Daylight Time and Energy: Evidence from an Australian Experiment
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Several countries are considering using Daylight Saving Time (DST) as a tool for energy conservation and reduction of greenhouse gas emissions, and the United States extended DST in 2007 with the goal of reducing electricity consumption. This paper assesses DST's impact on electricity demand by examining a quasi-experiment in which parts of Australia extended DST in 2000 to facilitate the Sydney Olympics. Using detailed panel data and a difference-in-difference-in-difference framework, we show that the extension did not reduce overall electricity consumption, but did cause a substantial intra-day shift in demand consistent with activity patterns that are tied to the clock rather than sunrise and sunset.
abstract_zh: 若干国家正考虑将夏令时（DST）作为节约能源和减少温室气体排放的工具，而美国于2007年延长了夏令时，目标是减少电力消费。本文借助一项准实验对夏令时对电力需求的影响进行了评估：澳大利亚部分地区于2000年延长夏令时，以配合悉尼奥运会。利用详细的面板数据和三重差分（DDD）框架，我们表明，这一延长并未减少总体电力消费，但确实引起了显著的日内需求转移，这与人们的活动模式与钟表时间而非日出日落相联系的情况相一致。

title: Environmental Consequences of Hydrocarbon Infrastructure Policy
abstract: The U.S. shale boom has profoundly increased crude oil movements by both pipelines-the traditional mode of transportation-and railroads. This paper develops a model of how pipeline investment and railroad use are determined in equilibrium, emphasizing how railroads' flexibility allows them to compete with pipelines. We show that policies that address crude-by-rail's environmental externalities by increasing its costs should lead to large increases in pipeline investment and substitution of oil flows from rail to pipe. Similarly, we find that policies enjoining pipeline construction would cause 80-90% of the displaced oil to flow by rail instead.
abstract_zh: 美国页岩热潮极大地增加了原油的运输量，既包括传统的运输方式——管道，也包括铁路。本文建立了一个模型，用以说明管道投资与铁路运输在均衡中是如何决定的，强调铁路的灵活性使其能够与管道展开竞争。我们表明，如果政策通过提高铁路原油运输的成本来应对其环境外部性，将导致管道投资大幅增加，并使石油流动从铁路大量转向管道。同样，我们发现，禁止建设管道将使80%至90%被替代的石油转而通过铁路运输。

title: The End of Oil
abstract: It is now plausible to envision scenarios in which global demand for crude oil falls to essentially zero by the end of this century, driven by improvements in clean energy technologies, adoption of stringent climate policies, or both. This paper asks what such a demand decline, when anticipated, might mean for global oil supply. One possibility is the well-known “green paradox”: because oil is an exhaustible resource, producers may accelerate near-term extraction in order to beat the demand decline. This reaction would increase near-term CO2 emissions and could possibly even lead the total present value of climate damages to be greater than if demand had not declined at all. However, because oil extraction requires potentially long-lived investments in wells and other infrastructure, the opposite may occur: an anticipated demand decline reduces producers' investment rates, decreasing near-term oil production and CO2 emissions. To evaluate whether this disinvestment effect outweighs the green paradox, or vice-versa, I develop a tractable model of global oil supply that incorporates both effects, while also capturing industry features such as heterogeneous producers, exercise of market power by low-cost OPEC producers, and marginal drilling costs that increase with the rate of drilling. I find that for model inputs with the strongest empirical support, the disinvestment effect outweighs the traditional green paradox. In order for anticipation effects on net to substantially increase cumulative global oil extraction, I find that industry investments must have short time horizons, and that producers must have discount rates that are comparable to U.S. treasury bill rates. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 现在，可以设想这样的情景：到本世纪末，全球原油需求将因清洁能源技术的进步、严格的气候政策，或两者兼有，而降至基本为零。本文探讨了，如果这种需求下降是可预期的，它可能对全球石油供给意味着什么。一种可能性是众所周知的“绿色悖论”：由于石油是可耗竭资源，生产者可能会加速近期开采，以抢在需求下降之前出售。这种反应会增加近期的二氧化碳排放，甚至可能导致气候损害的总现值高于需求根本没有下降的情形。然而，由于石油开采需要投资于可能寿命很长的油井和其他基础设施，相反的情况也可能发生：预期中的需求下降会降低生产者的投资率，从而减少近期的石油产量和二氧化碳排放。为了评估这种去投资效应是否会超过绿色悖论，或者相反，我建立了一个易于处理的全球石油供给模型，该模型同时纳入了这两种效应，并且还捕捉了异质性生产者、低成本OPEC生产者行使市场势力，以及边际钻井成本随钻井速度而上升等产业特征。我发现，对于有最强经验支持的模型输入，去投资效应超过了传统的绿色悖论。要使预期效应净额显著增加全球石油累计开采量，我发现，行业投资必须具有较短的时间跨度，并且生产者的贴现率必须与美国国库券利率相当。（NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者，以及发展中国家的居民，可以在www.nber.org免费下载本文。）
